page.description: PCLinuxOS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A user-friendly, out-of-the-box Linux distribution with excellent hardware support and a powerful package manager. Comes with a wide range of desktop applications pre-installed.
pros: Works out of the box with most hardware
Excellent package management with Synaptic and apt
Tools like Addlocale and Mylivecd for customization
cons: Main website behind Cloudflare challenge, difficult to access programmatically
Smaller community compared to Debian or Ubuntu
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for PCLinuxOS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the ISO image to a USB stick with dd, Rufus, or BalenaEtcher; writing erases the stick. Boot from BIOS/UEFI and follow the graphical installer.

editions.name: KDE Plasma
editions.description: The flagship edition with the modern KDE Plasma desktop, featuring the DarkStar theme option.
editions.usbNote: 4.0 GB image. Write it with dd or any image writer; writing erases the stick.
